section.title: Sending the weekly digest
section.scenario: A newsletter app sends each subscriber a weekly digest of new posts.
section.question: Which piece is the better design, and what decides it?
section.piece_a:
class WeeklyDigest
  def deliver(subscriber)
    posts = Post.published_since(1.week.ago)
    DigestMailer.weekly(subscriber, posts).deliver_later
  end
end
